people.name: Ulai
people.line: A river in Elam, near where Daniel saw a vision

translations.web: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”
translations.bsb: And I heard the voice of a man calling from between the banks of the Ulai: “Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.”
translations.kjv: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
translations.asv: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
